item.text: I agree with the form-validation and duplicate-error findings, and I’ll fix both. I’m also addressing the retry-count edge case by persisting whether a queued job is resuming an interrupted attempt: restarts can continue that attempt without inflating `attempts` past the three-attempt limit. Finally, I’ll catch unexpected server errors and return JSON when the response is still writable.
The reviewer’s four findings are addressed. I’ve added backward-compatible SQLite schema migration for the recovery marker; next I’m rebuilding and checking both process startup paths again.

item.text:
Addressed all four findings: disabled browser-side form blocking, deduplicated body validation errors, added JSON handling for unexpected server errors, and made interrupted attempts resume without exceeding the three-attempt limit.

The build passes and the worker starts and shuts down cleanly. I couldn’t verify server startup or run the smoke checks because this environment blocks localhost binds with `EPERM`.
